name: Lian Yu Ji: Zhi Meng Shu
source:
Deep into your dream, writing your own story, the ending is up to you!
Be success with your true love, with everyone's happiness;
Or failed by trapped in eternal nightmare...
Will you break your destiny with fragment of dreams?

[Translated from [url=https://weibo.com/7316544412/IhcKvmrb9?from=page_1006067316544412_profile&wvr=6&mod=weibotime]Weibo[/url]]
translation:
深入梦境，书写属于你的故事，结局由你决定！
是与真爱携手，让所有人收获幸福；
还是功亏一篑，永远困于噩梦之中……
你能否凭借梦境的碎片，打破命运？

[译自[url=https://weibo.com/7316544412/IhcKvmrb9?from=page_1006067316544412_profile&wvr=6&mod=weibotime]微博[/url]]
